what: Headless init records of Claude Code 2.1.296 (the skills the client lists), started in an empty directory with an environment and, for three runs, a settings overlay, killed at the init record before any model call: the client's switch for its bundled claude-api alone (CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_API_SKILL), with the plugin claude-api@anthropic-agent-skills enabled. bundled_claude_api_listed is the client's own claude-api (bare name), plugin_claude_api_listed the plugin's claude-api:claude-api.
source: the installed 2.1.296 binary, the function that initializes the bundled skills (byte offset 225255110 of the 257,068,216-byte binary): registerClaudeApiSkill({disabled: env.CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_API_SKILL === true}); the documentation and the changelog at the pin name neither the variable nor the function

reading.variable: 1, true, TRUE, yes, on and a padded ' 1' disable the bundled claude-api; 0, 2, false and an empty value do not (the same spellings as CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS)
reading.settings env entry: a string or a number enables it, and it overrides the process environment in both directions
reading.scope: one skill (77 to 76); with the all-bundled switch as well, 61: the plugin's skill stays listed in every run
